# Study 4: buy weekly options in the direction of the last weekly candle (auto-generated by `run_weekly.py`)

Weeks 2019-04-05 -> 2026-11-13 (395 weeks, 7.6 yrs), Friday 08:00 UTC entry, ATM strike, priced at REAL Deribit weekly IV paid by buyers (avg 69%), fees 0.03% in + 0.015% delivery. Avg premium 3.8% of spot. ETH moved >= 8% in 33% of weeks; when it did, it went in the signal's direction 59% of the time. Weekly return autocorrelation +0.068.

| YOUR RULE: up week -> buy call, down week -> buy put |   2,407 |     -1,765 |            34 |                      14 |            1.0 |                    260 |                683 |     395 |
| reverse: up week -> buy put, down week -> buy call   |  -4,501 |     -5,598 |            27 |                      15 |            1.0 |                    260 |              4,501 |     395 |
| always buy call                                      |    -280 |     -2,834 |            34 |                      14 |            1.0 |                    260 |                356 |     395 |
| always buy put                                       |  -1,815 |     -3,095 |            27 |                      20 |            1.0 |                    260 |              3,206 |     395 |
| buy straddle (0.5 call + 0.5 put)                    |  -1,105 |     -2,270 |            38 |                       9 |            1.0 |                    260 |              1,287 |     395 |


Permutation test (signals shuffled 3000x): real +2,407 vs shuffled mean -979, 5-95% -4,645..+2,488, **p = 0.057**. t-stat of weekly PnL in % of spot: 1.27.
